{{Top|leg}}
An '''Honors Platoon Guardsman''' was a member of the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard's]] [[Ailon First Honors Platoon]]. During ceremonies, each Guardsman carried a banner displaying [[Regiment/Legends|regimental]] honors. Each banner displayed up to thirty battle honors.
